definitions.explanation: The act of sleeping past one's intended wake-up time or later than usual.
A person who habitually sleeps late or has trouble waking up on time.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{朝寝坊|あさねぼう}をして{遅刻|ちこく}した。
examples.english: I overslept today and was late.
examples.notes: 朝寝坊をする is the common verb phrase for 'to oversleep'

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}は{朝寝坊|あさねぼう}で、いつも{母|はは}に{起|お}こされる。
examples.english: My younger brother is a late riser and always has to be woken up by our mother.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}くらい{朝寝坊|あさねぼう}したい。
examples.english: I want to sleep in at least on my days off.

examples.japanese: {朝寝坊|あさねぼう}して{学校|がっこう}に{遅|おく}れた。
examples.english: I overslept and was late for school.

examples.japanese: うちの{子|こ}は{朝寝坊|あさねぼう}で{困|こま}る。
examples.english: My child is such a late riser, it's a problem.
examples.notes: Na-adjective usage: {朝寝坊|あさねぼう}で

examples.japanese: {朝寝坊|あさねぼう}な{友達|ともだち}をいつも{起|お}こしに{行|い}く。
examples.english: I always go to wake up my friend who's a late riser.

notes:
{朝寝坊|あさねぼう} means both "oversleeping" and "a person who oversleeps."

FORMS:
- Noun: {朝寝坊|あさねぼう}をする (to oversleep)
- Na-adjective: {朝寝坊|あさねぼう}な{人|ひと} (a late-rising person)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {朝寝坊|あさねぼう}をして{遅刻|ちこく}した: I overslept and was late
- {朝寝坊|あさねぼう}したい: I want to sleep in

COMPONENTS:
{朝|あさ} (morning) + {寝坊|ねぼう} (oversleeping)

ANTONYM:
{早起|はやお}き: early rising, early riser
